title: How accurate have Ed Zitron's AI skeptic predictions been?
summary: This article evaluates Ed Zitron's past predictions about the AI industry, comparing them against actual developments. It examines his skeptical claims regarding AI hype, economic viability, and technical progress, finding mixed accuracy. The analysis highlights where his critiques were prescient and where they missed the mark, offering a nuanced view of AI's real-world impact versus media narratives.
